modules.scope: Minimal header-only compiler, invariant, version-value and cache-layout foundation.
modules.non_goals: Runtime version artifact, cache-topology discovery, native FFI and owning-module performance claims.
known_limitations: Compiler hints remain preconditioned and do not guarantee a cache hit or a chosen lowering.
Runtime topology and crash-reporting policy remain with their owning modules.
reopen_triggers: A real consumer exposes a correctness, security or missing-foundation defect.
A supported compiler or target invalidates the frozen code-generation contract.
A direct dependency changes Core semantics, or the public component/delivery boundary changes.
A strong peer proves a better complexity class or a reproducible material advantage for the same consumer contract.
modules.summary: P0 基础层已关闭；消费者性能声明由所属模块承担。

modules.scope: Current auto/safe member-hook intrusive-list capability, C++ API, implementation, direct consumer/dependency, delivery, documentation and P1 engineering evidence.
modules.non_goals: Full owning container, time/scheduler algorithms, reclamation or full intrusive policy matrix, C API/native FFI and Formal release certification.
known_limitations: The component is a 64-bit direct-member, stable-address primitive and fails closed for unsupported pointer-to-data-member representations.
It stores no owner, count, allocator, lock or reclamation metadata; callers own storage, synchronization and business-state mirrors.
Safe-link membership transfer, counted lists and the full Boost.Intrusive policy matrix remain outside the frozen consumer contract.
Engineering performance is qualified only for the frozen W1-WIN contract and retained live artifact bundle; Formal remains PENDING.
reopen_triggers: A named consumer exposes a correctness, security or missing-capability defect within this primitive's ownership boundary.
The algorithm, public API, layout, supported compiler ABI, dependency edge or delivery shape changes.
A mature same-contract peer proves a better complexity class or a reproducible material advantage on a normal consumer workload.
The engineering evidence bundle becomes unavailable, or the frozen contract, peer, machine or instrument identity changes and the claim must be renewed.
